claim_12.claim: microarray analysis of whole blood from 92 healthy male Caucasian volunteers ages 18–40 years immunized on day 0 with the 2008–2009 trivalent influenza vaccine, sampled before and on days 1, 3, and 14 after immunization, using content analysis, showed enrichment of top pathways including the interferon response and antigen presentation pathways among genes upregulated in the high-responder group compared to the low-responder group.

sources.quote: Content analysis of the genes that were upregulated in the high- responder group showed enrichment of GO categories involved in cellular immune responses, most notably the interferon re- sponse and antigen presentation pathways (Figure 3A and Da- tasets 9, 10).

(A) Top enriched pathways in the high responder group. The negative log P value, along the x-axis, increases as a pathway is more significantly associated. The ratio indicates the proportion of upregulated genes relative to all the genes present in a pathway.

claim_13.claim: microarray analysis of whole blood from 92 healthy male Caucasian volunteers ages 18–40 years immunized on day 0 with the 2008–2009 trivalent influenza vaccine, sampled before and on days 1, 3, and 14 after immunization, showed that interferon pathway genes were preferentially upregulated in the high-responder group compared to the low-responder group.

sources.quote: Genes within the interferon response pathway were highly upregulated in the high-responder group (Figure 3B).
(B) Genes that act in the interferon pathway and which are preferentially upregulated in the high vaccine responders are shown in red.
